description: This file is a database migration script for the Apache Superset project, specifically handling security permissions related to saved queries. It defines upgrade and downgrade functions to modify permissions using Alembic and SQLAlchemy.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs the permission upgrade by adding new permissions and migrating roles within a database session.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts the permission changes by restoring previous permissions within a database session.
